privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains how personal data is processed within Renderhane, operated by data controller Turgut Ürer. Please also read the KVKK Data Protection Notice for the detailed statutory disclosure.
privacy.section1Content:
Depending on how you use the service, we may process:

• Identity and contact data: name, surname, email
• Account and authentication data: user ID, Google OAuth details, profile photo
• Transaction and content data: uploads, prompts, generated outputs, job and credit history
• Payment data: order, package, and payment status; payment-card data is processed by the payment provider and is not stored by Renderhane
• Technical and security data: IP address, device/browser, access and error logs
• Support data: messages and records relating to your request
privacy.section2Content: Data is processed to create and manage accounts, provide the service, administer credits and payments, maintain security, prevent misuse, provide support, and comply with legal duties. Depending on the activity, processing relies on the legal bases in KVKK Art. 5/2, including performance of a contract, legal obligation, establishment or protection of a right, and legitimate interests that do not prejudice fundamental rights. Analytics, advertising, and marketing rely on separate consent where required; the core service is not conditional on optional consent.
privacy.section3Content: Data is retained only for as long as the purpose and applicable law require, then deleted, destroyed, or anonymised. An account-closure request does not override mandatory retention duties or records needed for ongoing disputes. Reasonable technical and organisational measures such as access controls, transport security, monitoring, and backups are used against unauthorised access, loss, and misuse. No internet system can promise absolute security.
privacy.section4Content:
When the relevant feature is used, data may be shared on a need-to-know basis with:

• Supabase — database and authentication
• Cloudflare — content delivery and file storage
• fal.ai — AI model processing
• Google — OAuth and, with consent, Analytics and AdSense
• Panola — analytics with consent
• iyzico — payment processing
• Resend — transactional email

Where data is transferred abroad, an applicable transfer condition and safeguard under KVKK Art. 9 is required.
privacy.section5Content: Account and transaction records may be kept while the account relationship continues; uploads and outputs until you delete them, close the account, or they are no longer needed. Payment and accounting records are retained for periods required by tax and commercial law; security logs for a proportionate operational period. You can change cookie choices through “Cookie Preferences” in the footer.
privacy.section6Content: To exercise your rights under KVKK Art. 11 or ask a privacy question, write from your registered email address to turgut.urer@gmail.com. Data controller: Turgut Ürer. Address: Denizköşkler Mahallesi, Hasan Çelebi Sokak No: 19, Avcılar/Istanbul, Türkiye. The KVKK Data Protection Notice explains the application procedure.

kvkk.title: KVKK Data Protection Notice
kvkk.intro: Under Turkish Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 (“KVKK”), your personal data is processed by data controller Turgut Ürer within the scope described below.
kvkk.section1Content:
Data controller: Turgut Ürer
Address: Denizköşkler Mahallesi, Hasan Çelebi Sokak No: 19, Avcılar/Istanbul, Türkiye
KVKK application email: turgut.urer@gmail.com
General contact: info@renderhane.com
kvkk.section2Content: Depending on your use, we may process name, surname, email, user and OAuth identifiers, profile photo; uploads and prompts, generated outputs, job and credit history; order and payment status; IP, device/browser, access, error and security logs; cookie/similar technology choices; and support correspondence. Payment-card details are processed by the payment provider and are not stored by Renderhane.
kvkk.section3Content:
• Account creation, authentication, service and credit delivery: KVKK Art. 5/2(c), establishment or performance of a contract
• Invoicing, accounting, and authority requests: Art. 5/2(ç), legal obligation
• Claims, objections, and disputes: Art. 5/2(e), establishment, exercise, or protection of a right
• Security, debugging, and misuse prevention: Art. 5/2(f), legitimate interests without prejudice to fundamental rights
• Analytics, advertising personalisation, and optional marketing: Art. 5/1, separate and withdrawable consent

Notice and consent are handled separately; consent is not requested where another lawful basis applies.
kvkk.section4Content: Data is collected by automated or partly automated means through registration and payment forms, uploads and generation operations, support communications, authentication providers, server and security logs, and optional cookies/similar technologies only where you permit them.
kvkk.section5Content:
Data may be shared only as necessary with Supabase (database/authentication), Cloudflare (delivery/storage), fal.ai (AI processing), Google (OAuth and, with consent, Analytics/AdSense), Panola (analytics with consent), iyzico (payments), Resend (transactional email), competent authorities, and legal or financial advisers.

Where data is transferred to overseas providers, one of the valid transfer conditions and any applicable safeguard under KVKK Art. 9 must be used. You may ask the data controller which current mechanism applies.
kvkk.section6Content: Data is retained while required by the processing purpose, contractual relationship, statutory periods, and limitation needs. Account/content data is deleted, destroyed, or anonymised after a deletion or closure request when no overriding duty remains; payment/accounting data after statutory periods; and technical/security logs after a risk-proportionate operational period. Deletion from backups completes through the technical backup cycle.
kvkk.section7Content: Under KVKK Art. 11, you may ask whether data is processed; request information; learn the purpose and whether use is consistent with it; know domestic or overseas recipients; request correction; request deletion or destruction under Art. 7; request notification of those operations to recipients; object to an adverse result produced solely by automated analysis; and claim compensation for unlawful processing.
kvkk.section8Content: You may send a written application to Denizköşkler Mahallesi, Hasan Çelebi Sokak No: 19, Avcılar/Istanbul, Türkiye, or email turgut.urer@gmail.com from an address you previously provided to Renderhane and that is registered in our systems. Include your name, signature for written applications, identity/contact details, the request, and information reasonably needed to verify it. Do not send an unnecessary copy of your identity document. Applications are answered free of charge within 30 days; the Board tariff may apply where an additional cost is incurred.

cookiePolicy.title: Cookie and Similar Technologies Policy
cookiePolicy.intro: This policy describes cookies, local storage, and third-party technologies used by Renderhane. Optional analytics and advertising technologies are disabled by default.
cookiePolicy.section1Content: Cookies are small data files stored by your browser. Local storage similarly keeps preferences on your device but is not sent with every request. These technologies are used only for the purposes described here.
cookiePolicy.section2Content:
• Supabase session data (name may vary with authentication configuration): secure sign-in and session management
• NEXT_LOCALE: language preference; session cookie
• cookie-consent-v2: stores analytics and advertising choices in browser local storage
• Security/load-balancing data: safe and reliable service operation

These are used only where necessary for a service you requested or for security.
cookiePolicy.section3Content: If you allow analytics, Google Analytics and Panola scripts are loaded. They may measure page views, device/browser data, and approximate usage. Google Analytics may use _ga, _gid, and similar identifiers. Refusing analytics does not prevent use of core features.
cookiePolicy.section4Content: If you allow advertising, Google AdSense loads only on public publisher-content pages where ads may be shown. Google may use third-party identifiers for ad delivery and measurement. Advertising consent can be changed separately from analytics consent.
cookiePolicy.section5Content: Strictly necessary technologies rely, according to their function, on performance of a contract under KVKK Art. 5/2(c) or legitimate interests under Art. 5/2(f). Analytics and advertising technologies rely on prior, specific, and withdrawable consent under Art. 5/1. KVKK Art. 9 also applies where a provider such as Google receives data abroad.
cookiePolicy.section6Content:
On your first visit, you can “Reject All”, “Manage Preferences”, or “Accept All”. Reopen the panel at any time through “Cookie Preferences” in the footer. Withdrawal applies prospectively, and removable first-party analytics identifiers are cleared. You can also delete third-party identifiers in browser settings.

Questions: turgut.urer@gmail.com

about.metaDescription: Renderhane is an AI-powered visual production studio for e-commerce sellers. Discover our story, mission and technology.
about.title: About Us
about.intro: Renderhane is an AI-powered visual production platform that brings e-commerce sellers' product images up to professional studio quality. From a single product photo we generate 3D models, scene compositions, A+ content visuals, promotional videos and social media packs — without expensive shooting equipment, a photo studio or a design team.
about.missionBody: To let small and medium-sized businesses compete on the same visual quality as large brands. We believe every seller with a great product deserves access to visuals that show it at its best. While traditional product photography takes days and costs a fortune, Renderhane brings it down to minutes and an affordable price. Our goal is to turn visual production from a barrier into an accelerator of growth.
about.howBody: The process has just three steps. First you upload a single photo of your product — even a plain shot taken with your phone is enough. Then you choose what you want to create: a background-removed product image, a scene showing the product in a living space, a rotatable 3D model, or A+ content for a marketplace. Finally our AI engines produce the result in seconds; if you are not satisfied you can try different variations and fine-tune. You own the commercial rights to every output produced.
about.techBody: Renderhane combines industry-leading AI models in a single, user-friendly interface. We use TRELLIS and Hunyuan3D for 3D model generation, BiRefNet for background removal, and the latest diffusion models for image generation and enhancement. We select, configure and continuously update these models for you — you never need to know which model does what. Our infrastructure is optimised for the Turkish market: a Turkish interface, local payments via iyzico and Turkish-language support.
about.whoBody: E-commerce sellers on marketplaces like Trendyol, Hepsiburada, Amazon and Etsy; brands running their own web stores; entrepreneurs promoting products on social media; and agencies producing fast visuals for their clients. Whether you are a one-person business or manage a catalogue of hundreds of products, Renderhane scales to fit. Try it with our free tools, then move to credit packs as your needs grow.
about.ctaBody: Try our free tools with no credit card required, or create an account to access all features.

contact.intro: Don't hesitate to reach out with your questions, support requests or partnership proposals. Our team is happy to help in Turkish and English, and we usually reply to emails within one business day.
contact.emailBody: For general questions, support and partnerships:
contact.supportBody: If you are experiencing a technical issue with your account, credit packs or a production job, including your account email and the relevant job number (if any) in your email helps us resolve it faster.
contact.businessBody: For agencies, high-volume sellers and enterprise integration requests (API access, Shopify and marketplace connections), reach us at the same email address. We will work with you to find a solution that fits your needs.
contact.hoursBody: We monitor incoming email every weekday. We reply to most messages within 24 hours, and at the latest within one business day.
